title: Composer send button disappears during active turns causing layout shift
description: In web/components/assistant-ui/ChatticusAssistantThread.tsx, AuiIf wraps ComposerPrimitive.Send with condition state => !state.thread.isRunning. When a turn is active or sending, the Send button is completely unmounted from the DOM rather than being rendered in a disabled or loading state. This causes layout jitter in the composer footer and leaves no visual feedback indicating that a turn is running.

comments.author: home
comments.text: Resolved in PR #356 (merged at 402263e). Composer send button remains mounted and disabled during active turns, eliminating layout jitter.
